capture_contract.note: The Kraken payload is the exact JSON text rendered by the retrieval interface, not byte-complete HTTP wire data. Provider publication/update timestamps are kept separate from retrieval time.

kraken_xrp_usd.hash_scope: SHA-256 of the exact JSON text rendered in the retrieval result; not a hash of raw HTTP wire bytes.
limitations: Kraken supplied no provider event timestamp or sequence identifier in this response.
The returned bid/ask is top-of-book only, not full depth or executable size beyond the displayed quantities.
The observation is one venue and is not synchronized to the TradRadar futures update.
The observation is not admitted to the point-in-time feature store.

methodology_limits: The page aggregates seven venues and displays a 15-minute delay; the exact underlying timestamp is not exposed.
Liquidations are a lower bound because exchanges publish only part of real-time liquidations.
Long/short is an account-count ratio, not notional positioning.
USD-notional open interest can decline partly because XRP price declines; it is not a pure contract-count measure.
The aggregation is one provider's presentation of venue data, not seven independent provider confirmations.

xrp_insights.universe: Six US spot XRP ETFs plus the XRP sleeve of Bitwise 10 Crypto Index Fund (BITW).
xrp_insights.flow_method: Day-over-day change in issuer-reported XRP holdings; not a direct AP cash creation/redemption feed.
exclusions_and_limits: Funds with a known capture gap can have flow_status=excluded and contribute zero to aggregate flow.
GXRP flow is withheld because the issuer page blocked automated reads from 2026-09-02 to 2026-09-28; holdings remain in totals.
Some historical rows are reconstructed from third-party daily flow estimates between issuer-reported anchor days.
BITW is a multi-asset index fund; its XRP sleeve can change through index rebalancing.
Holdings changes can include fees/rewards and do not prove open-market purchases.

cryptokeyhole.universe: Four US spot XRP funds: Bitwise XRP, Franklin XRPZ, Canary XRPC and 21Shares TOXR.
cryptokeyhole.flow_method: Changes in issuer-published holdings; the publisher notes flows can also reflect staking rewards and coins sold for fees or cash payouts.
limitations: The November 5 figure is partial, not a completed four-fund day.
Its four-fund universe differs from XRP Insights' six spot funds plus BITW.
It cannot be averaged with XRP Insights' four-day aggregate.

non_comparable_universe.methodology_conflict: The page's top-holder list includes the multi-asset NCIQ index ETF while its methodology says NCIQ and other basket funds are not counted in the direct-XRP-fund total.
non_comparable_universe.treatment: Excluded from quantitative reconciliation until the publisher clarifies the fund universe and whether NCIQ is included in the 10-fund total.

other_quality_flags.issue: The page reports 12 active products while its visible category counts sum to 11 (6 spot + 4 derivative + 1 index).
other_quality_flags.treatment: Excluded from quantitative flow synthesis pending product-count clarification.

other_quality_flags.issue: The page labels a November 6 latest-session flow while its stated check time is 04:15 UTC, before the November 6 US regular ETF session.
other_quality_flags.treatment: Excluded from November 6 XRP flow inference pending a clear date/time convention.

macro_event.rule: Do not substitute survey expectations for the release. Preserve the initial release and later revisions as separate vintages.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: The sharp 24-hour decline, falling OI, long-heavy liquidations and positive but modest funding are consistent with a leveraged-long unwind.
supporting_evidence: TradRadar reports -9.09% 24-hour mark-price change, -7.16% OI, at least $19.91M liquidations with $19.28M long liquidations, and 79.8% long accounts.
counterevidence: The OI measure is USD notional and may fall partly with price; long/short is account counts; liquidation reporting is incomplete; the data is asynchronous and one aggregator.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Broader cross-asset risk reduction may have contributed to XRP selling.
supporting_evidence: Earlier November 5 equity-risk context is preserved in a separate artifact.
counterevidence: No synchronized XRP/equity event study or causal estimate is present in this capture.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Small holdings-derived ETF outflows may have reduced marginal demand at the margin.
supporting_evidence: XRP Insights reports -149,487 XRP over November 2-5 in its seven-instrument universe.
counterevidence: The approximate $201K is small relative to reported ETF holdings; CryptoKeyhole reports a partial three-of-four November 5 figure; flows are holdings deltas, not AP cash or verified spot execution.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Differences across spot, derivatives and ETF sources mainly reflect distinct update times, venue universes and coverage rules.
supporting_evidence: Kraken has no provider timestamp; TradRadar shows a 15-minute delay; XRP Insights and CryptoKeyhole use different ETF universes and settlement states.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: An XRP-specific corporate, protocol or regulatory event dominated the immediate move.
counterevidence: No synchronized primary-source catalyst is established by this artifact.

quality_and_limits.reason: Asynchronous public observations, incomplete source timestamps, differing ETF universes and non-byte-complete receipts do not form a synchronized point-in-time feature set.

forecast_status.reason: No synchronized historical feature set or evaluator-attested out-of-sample lift supports a directional XRP forecast.
